description: [PAID $0.002 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Reachability check of a URL as a browser: status code, latency in milliseconds, server header, content type, size in bytes and a blocked flag when the origin answers 401/403/429/503. Cheaper than a full fetch when an agent only needs to know if a source is alive.
name: web_status
